Agent Guard

Resilient, zero-telemetry local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, keep-awake supervisor, and Antigravity Stop hook for autonomous AI pairing.

Developer: Sarvesh | GitHub: anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard

--- ## ⚡ Instant Setup (One Command / One Prompt) ### 💻 One Terminal Command (Auto-Detects All Installed Coding Apps): ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard/main/install.sh | bash ``` *Auto-detects and configures **Antigravity**, **Claude Code**, **Cursor**, **Codex CLI**, **Gemini CLI**, **Windsurf**, **VS Code (Cline/Roo)**, and **Zed**.* ### 🤖 The Universal Agent Prompt (Copy & Paste to Any AI Agent): > **"Please install and activate the Agent Guard MCP supervisor (https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard.git). Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard/main/install.sh | bash` in the terminal, verify with `node ~/.agent-guard/dist/cli.js doctor`, and adopt the `@agent-guard` rules to supervise all my development tasks with atomic ledger checkpoints and keep-awake protection."** 📖 *See **[UNIVERSAL_INSTALL_PROMPT.md](UNIVERSAL_INSTALL_PROMPT.md)** for app-by-app guides and configuration paths.* --- ## Why Agent Guard? Autonomous AI coding agents in modern IDEs like Google Antigravity excel at single-turn instructions, but frequently encounter catastrophic failure modes during extended, multi-step work: 1. **Premature Abandonment**: The agent declares victory and halts before running tests or finishing dependent steps. 2. **Context Window Bloat**: Repeatedly crawling deep file hierarchies and receiving thousands of redundant tokens in status output. 3. **Session Amnesia**: When a chat hits context limits or crashes, all task memory is lost and the agent restarts from scratch. 4. **Unattended Sleep**: Complex tasks stall midway because the computer's display or idle sleep kicks in while you step away. **Agent Guard** (`agent-guard`) solves all four problems with zero external infrastructure: - 💾 **File-Backed Atomic Ledger**: Keeps track of every step in `.agent/ledger.json` with self-healing recovery and concurrency locking. - 🛑 **Antigravity Stop Hook**: Soft-blocks premature termination until all tasks are complete, with an integrated loop breaker. - ☕ **Supervised Keep-Awake Lease**: Keeps the computer awake using native OS tools (`caffeinate`) with an 8-hour safety ceiling. - ⚡ **Ultra-Lean Token Protocol**: 5 concise MCP tools designed from the ground up to conserve prompt tokens. - 🤖 **Chat Mention `@agent-guard`**: Summon Agent Guard directly in Antigravity or AI coding chat by typing `@agent-guard`. - 🔄 **GitHub Push Auto-Update**: CI/CD auto-releases on push to `main`; clients self-update via `npm run update` or `./install.sh --update`. --- ## System Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Antigravity ["Google Antigravity"] Agent["Autonomous AI Agent"] HookEngine["Stop Hook Engine"] Rules["Workspace Rules (AGENTS.md)"] end subgraph AgentGuard ["agent-guard (Node 20+ / TypeScript)"] MCPServer["MCP Server (stdio)\nsrc/index.ts"] Tools["5 Core Tools\ntask_start | task_checkpoint | task_status\nkeep_awake | repo_brief"] Ledger["Safe Ledger Engine\n(Locking, Atomic Rename, Auto-Repair)"] AwakeMgr["Awake Supervisor\n(Lease Ticker, Swap, 8h Ceiling)"] StopHook["Stop Hook Script\n(3-Idle Push Loop Breaker)"] end subgraph Project ["Target Repository: /"] AgentDir[".agent/"] LedgerJson[".agent/ledger.json\n(Task & Step States)"] BriefMd[".agent/brief.md\n(Cached Map < 1.5k tok)"] HookState[".agent/hook-state.json\n(Push Counters)"] LogTxt[".agent/log.txt\n(1MB Rotated Audit Log)"] end Rules -->|Guides Calls| Agent Agent <-->|MCP Protocol| MCPServer MCPServer --> Tools Tools --> Ledger Tools --> AwakeMgr Ledger --> AgentDir HookEngine -->|Fires on Exit| StopHook StopHook --> LedgerJson StopHook --> HookState StopHook -->|continue or allow| HookEngine ``` --- ## Core Pillars ### 1. 🛡️ Zero Telemetry & Local Sandboxing * **100% Offline & Private**: Zero network dependencies, zero tracking, no cloud telemetry. * **Strict Path Sandboxing**: Resolves canonical realpaths; strictly jails writes to `/.agent/`. Disallows the root directory, user home directory, OS system folders, and paths lacking `.git` or `.agent`. ### 2. ⚡ Maximum Token Economy * Context window consumption is minimized at every level: * `task_start`: Concise initialization response (~150 tokens). * `task_checkpoint`: Single action instruction <= 300 characters (~60 tokens). * `task_status`: High-density snapshot under 500 tokens, even with 30 steps. * `repo_brief`: Fast, one-shot repository summary (< 1,500 tokens; hard cap at 8,000 characters) that prevents the agent from crawling dozens of files. * Automatic string truncation with `[cut]` for goals (500 chars), titles (200 chars), and notes (500 chars). * Disk-only rotation logging (`.agent/log.txt` at 1MB); zero debug spam injected into model context. ### 3. 💾 Crash-Proof, Self-Healing State Ledger * **Atomic Writes**: Writes to `.agent/ledger.tmp` followed by atomic filesystem `rename`. * **Lock Contention**: Concurrency locking (`.agent/ledger.lock`) with 30-second stale lock eviction. * **Automatic Recovery**: Backs up prior state to `ledger.prev.json` before writing; automatically self-heals and restores state if corruption is ever detected on read. ### 4. 🔄 Resilient Step & Retry Machine * **Proof Verification**: Marking a step `done` requires at least 10 non-whitespace characters of verification proof in the note (e.g. test outputs or compile results). * **Retry Escalation**: Failed steps increment retries up to `max_tries` (default 3); automatically transitions to `blocked` once exhausted. * **Dependency Cascading**: Automatically cascades `blocked` status to any dependent steps down the DAG. * **Strict Prioritization**: The next step is always selected deterministically: $$\text{in\_progress} \longrightarrow \text{failed (with retries)} \longrightarrow \text{first ready pending}$$ ### 5. ☕ Supervised Keep-Awake Leases * Prevents unattended computers from sleeping during long builds, tests, or multi-step execution. * Native OS helpers: * **macOS**: `caffeinate -di -t -w ` with seamless child swapping (no sleep gap) and battery discharge warnings. * **Windows**: PowerShell `SetThreadExecutionState` continuous wrapper. * **Linux**: `systemd-inhibit --what=idle:sleep`. * Auto-expiring lease renewed at every checkpoint, guarded by an **8-hour hard ceiling**. ### 6. 🛑 Antigravity Stop Hook & Loop Breaker * Wired via Antigravity's `.agents/hooks.json`. * Detects premature agent stops: if unfinished, unblocked steps remain, soft-pushes the agent back to continue. * **Loop Breaker**: If the agent makes no checkpoint progress for 3 consecutive pushes, or reaches 10 total pushes, allows stop to prevent runaway loops. * **Fail-Safe**: Fully wrapped in exception handling; never stalls or traps the IDE. --- ## MCP Tools Reference | Tool | Purpose | Token Cost | Inputs | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `task_start` | Starts a tracked task, validates step DAG, begins 30m awake lease | ~150 tokens | `goal`, `steps`, `max_tries?`, `replace?`, `project_path?` | | `task_checkpoint` | Reports progress (`in_progress`, `done`, `failed`), verifies proof, extends lease | ~60 tokens | `step_id`, `status`, `note`, `error?`, `add_steps?`, `project_path?` | | `task_status` | Read-only inspection of active step, blocked items, and next action | < 500 tokens | `project_path?` | | `keep_awake` | Explicitly holds, releases, or inspects sleep inhibition lease | ~40 tokens | `action` (`hold`/`release`/`status`), `minutes?`, `reason?` | | `repo_brief` | Fast project overview with ASCII directory map & architecture chart | < 1,500 tokens | `refresh?`, `project_path?` | | `agent_enforce` | Communicates directives with active agents and forces task completion | ~60 tokens | `action` (`status`/`broadcast`/`force_next`), `directive?`, `target_agent?` | --- ## Quickstart & Installation For the comprehensive setup manual and deep-dive troubleshooting, see the [Installation Guide (INSTALL.md)](INSTALL.md). ### ⚡ 1-Click Universal Git Install Clone and install Agent Guard with a single command on any machine: ```bash git clone https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard.git ~/.agent-guard && ~/.agent-guard/install.sh ``` Or from an existing local clone: ```bash cd agent-guard ./install.sh ``` --- ## 🛠️ Configuring Your AI Coding App Agent Guard operates as a standard [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server over `stdio`. Use the configuration snippet below for your environment:
1. Google Antigravity (IDE, App 2.0, CLI agy) The automated installer configures Antigravity automatically. To configure manually, add to `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "agent-guard": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js"] } } } ``` **Antigravity Stop Hook** (`.agents/hooks.json` in your workspace): ```json { "agent-guard-stop": { "Stop": [ { "type": "command", "command": "node /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/hook/stop-hook.js" } ] } } ```
2. Claude Code CLI Add with a single CLI command: ```bash claude mcp add agent-guard -- node /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js ``` Or add to `~/.claude/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "agent-guard": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js"] } } } ```
3. Cursor IDE Navigate to **Settings → Features → MCP → Add New MCP Server**, or edit `~/.cursor/mcp.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "agent-guard": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js"] } } } ```
4. Windsurf (Codeium / Cascade) Add to `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "agent-guard": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js"] } } } ```
5. VS Code (Cline / Roo Code / Continue) Add to `cline_mcp_settings.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "agent-guard": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js"], "disabled": false, "autoApprove": [ "task_start", "task_checkpoint", "task_status", "repo_brief", "keep_awake" ] } } } ```
6. Zed Editor Add to `~/.config/zed/settings.json`: ```json { "experimental": { "model_context_protocol": { "servers": { "agent-guard": { "command": "node", "args": ["/absolute/path/to/agent-guard/dist/index.js"] } } } } } ```
--- ## 🎯 Target Workspace Setup To enable Agent Guard's autonomous supervision in any target project: ```bash ./install.sh --workspace "/path/to/your/project" ``` This installs: 1. **`.agents/hooks.json`**: Prevents the agent from abandoning work before all steps are complete and verified. 2. **`AGENTS.md`**: Provides clear system instructions directing the model to start tasks, inspect code maps before touching files, verify work with >= 10-char proof notes, and retry failed steps before continuing. --- ## 🤖 Invoking with Chat Mention (`@agent-guard`) Agent Guard is packaged as a native Antigravity Plugin and Subagent. You can summon Agent Guard directly in your conversation simply by typing **`@agent-guard`**: ```text @agent-guard refactor auth service and run all integration tests before finishing ``` When invoked via `@agent-guard`: 1. The agent adopts the **Agent Guard** supervisor persona. 2. It automatically checks active tasks via `task_status`. 3. It takes a lightweight repository snapshot via `repo_brief`. 4. It initializes the DAG ledger with `task_start` and activates the keep-awake sleep lease. 5. It validates each completed step with test results via `task_checkpoint`. --- ## 🔄 GitHub Push & Auto-Update Pipeline Agent Guard includes automated CI/CD and self-updating capabilities: ### 1. Automatic GitHub Release on Push Every push to `main` on [https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard.git](https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard.git) automatically triggers GitHub Actions to: * Validate cross-platform builds across Node 20 & 22 on macOS, Linux, and Windows. * Run the complete Vitest test suite. * Build and package release tarballs (`agent-guard-*.tgz`). * Update the floating `latest` git tag and publish a GitHub Release with updated changelog and assets. ### 2. Updating Your Local Installation You can update your local Agent Guard installation at any time with a single command: ```bash # Via NPM script: npm run update # Or via install script: ./install.sh --update # Or via CLI binary: node dist/cli.js update ``` The updater pulls changes from `origin/main`, recompiles TypeScript (`dist/`), and re-runs the readiness doctor. ### 3. Non-Blocking Background Checks When running as an MCP server, Agent Guard quietly checks upstream git status in the background (debounced to at most once per hour). If updates are detected, it signals readiness without blocking your coding agent or interrupting offline work. --- ## 🗺️ Project Map & Architecture Chart Agent Guard includes a built-in codebase mapper that produces clean directory trees and Mermaid component flowcharts: ```bash # Generate and print project map + save .agent/project_map.md: npm run map # Or via CLI for any target workspace: node dist/cli.js map --workspace "/path/to/project" ``` The `repo_brief` tool automatically embeds this map into `.agent/brief.md` (<1,500 tokens), allowing AI coding agents to navigate the codebase instantly without crawling deep directory hierarchies. --- ## ⚡ Seamless IDE Auto-Accept Never get interrupted by approval popups for supervisor actions. The installer automatically registers `autoApprove` permissions for all Agent Guard MCP tools and terminal actions in Antigravity (`config.json`), Cursor (`mcp.json`), and VS Code / Cline: ```bash npm run install:antigravity ``` --- ## Verification & Doctor Agent Guard includes a built-in diagnostic doctor to verify all integrations: ```bash npm run doctor ``` ``` 🩺 Agent Guard Readiness Doctor • Node version: v24.22.0 (/Users/sarvesh/.local/node-v24/bin/node) • MCP Config: [OK] agent-guard is registered in mcp_config.json • Mention @agent-guard: [OK] Plugin active in Antigravity • Auto-Accept IDE: [OK] Tool and command permissions granted • Auto-Update: [OK] Up to date with origin/main • Server Binary: [OK] dist/index.js • Stop Hook: [OK] dist/hook/stop-hook.js • Enforce Hook: [OK] dist/hook/post-invocation-hook.js • Sleep Inhibitor: [OK] macOS caffeinate available ``` Run the automated test suite: ```bash npm test ``` ``` Test Files 10 passed (10) Tests 60 passed (60) Duration 1.85s ``` --- ## 🌟 Curated Awesome Skills Catalog (2,740+ Skills) Agent Guard bundles a massive reverse-engineered collection of **2,740+ curated agentic skills** across 100+ domains, featuring `@agent-guard` as the apex autonomous supervisor. Explore the complete catalog in **[AWESOME_SKILLS.md](AWESOME_SKILLS.md)**. ### Built-in Skills Manager CLI: ```bash # List featured & core skills npm run skills list # Search skills by domain or keyword npm run skills search security npm run skills search devops npm run skills search "ai agent" # Inspect detailed metadata for any skill npm run skills info ai-agents-architect # Install a skill into your Antigravity skills directory npm run skills install clean-architecture npm run skills install security-audit --path ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills # View all available categories npm run skills categories ``` ### Pre-bundled Core Skills: * 🤖 **`agent-guard`**: Autonomous task supervisor, DAG checkpoints, OS keep-awake, multi-agent completion enforcer. * 🧠 **`ai-agents-architect`**: Multi-agent system architecture, tool routing, ReAct loops, fail-safe degradation. * 🛡️ **`security-audit`**: Zero-trust vulnerability audit, secret leakage detection, OWASP hardening. * 🏛️ **`clean-architecture`**: Domain-driven boundaries, hexagonal ports & adapters, interface segregation. * 🚀 **`devops-automation`**: GitHub Actions workflows, multi-stage Docker builds, container orchestration. * 🧪 **`test-driven-development`**: Red-Green-Refactor enforcement with verifiable test proofs. * ⚡ **`performance-profiling`**: Node/V8 heap analysis, event-loop lag monitoring, hot-path optimization. * 🔍 **`reverse-engineering`**: Static AST reconstruction, binary inspection, and protocol analysis with REA. --- ## 👨‍💻 Developer & Author * **Developer**: **Sarvesh** ([@anksarvesh-lgtm](https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm)) * **Project Repository**: [https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard.git](https://github.com/anksarvesh-lgtm/agent-guard.git) Contributions, feature suggestions, and pull requests are warmly welcomed! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). --- ## Free Software License Agent Guard is free and open-source software licensed under the **[Apache License, Version 2.0](LICENSE)**. You are free to use, modify, distribute, and embed Agent Guard for personal, academic, or commercial purposes. See the [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) file for the full license text.
